memory_annotations.evidence_summary: No recurring travel preference was established. Avery selected the Hyatt for this Columbus visit because relatives can provide most rides, making its complete lodging and transportation cost lower despite the higher room rate; the flexible cancellation terms also remained available.

messages.content: Sunday lunch is confirmed to end at noon, so I booked the Friday afternoon and Sunday 3:30 p.m. nonstop flights for both of us. Now compare the two hotel choices with all local transportation included.

For Friday, October 16 through Sunday, October 18, I found two rooms still available. The Hyatt Place Columbus/OSU near Grandview is $189 per night, with a two-night total of $432.18 after taxes. Your relatives can handle the airport and family-event rides from there, so you would only need to allow about $20 for an incidental rideshare. The Wayfaring Buckeye in the University District is $154 per night and $354.76 after taxes, but its location adds an estimated six rideshare trips totaling $112-$138. That makes the complete local totals $452.18 for the Hyatt versus $466.76-$492.76 for the Wayfaring Buckeye.
Does the Hyatt total include parking? We will not have a car, but I do not want a parking fee buried in it.

No parking charge is included. The $432.18 consists of the $378 room subtotal plus $54.18 in state and local lodging taxes. Parking is charged only if a vehicle is registered to the room, so it will not apply to your stay.
And the cheaper hotel's number is also complete? No separate cleaning or service fee?

Correct. Its $354.76 total includes the room charges, taxes, and its listed service fee. There is no cleaning fee. The uncertainty is transportation: current rideshare estimates are $18-$23 from CMH on Friday, roughly $12-$16 each way for two family gatherings, and $20-$27 back to CMH Sunday. With six projected trips, that is $112-$138 before surge pricing or tips.
Please check actual room availability for one room and two adults, and compare cancellation deadlines. A king is fine.

Both properties currently show one king room available for two adults. At the Hyatt, the $432.18 rate can be canceled without charge until 11:59 p.m. local time on Wednesday, October 14; after that, the penalty is one night's room and tax. The Wayfaring Buckeye's quoted rate is refundable only until 3:00 p.m. Monday, October 12, after which the entire $354.76 becomes nonrefundable.
What would the Hyatt cost if we chose the more flexible rate, assuming that is not already the one you quoted?

The quoted Hyatt rate is already its flexible rate. There is a prepaid option at $407.66 total, but it becomes nonrefundable immediately. Keeping the flexible rate costs $24.52 more and preserves cancellation through October 14.
Then the Hyatt is effectively less expensive once we count the rides. Is the Friday airport pickup workable for our relatives, or would arrival traffic make that unreasonable?

Your flight is scheduled into CMH at 2:35 p.m. A pickup around 3:00 should reach the Hyatt near 3:20 under ordinary Friday traffic. Even allowing 20 extra minutes, that leaves ample time before the 5:30 family dinner. On Sunday, leaving the hotel at 12:35 p.m. after lunch should put you at CMH around 1:00 for the 3:30 departure.
Good. Book the Hyatt king at $432.18 using the flexible cancellation terms. Use the traveler and payment details already on the reservation profile.

Before I submit it: one king room at Hyatt Place Columbus/OSU for two adults, checking in Friday, October 16 and checking out Sunday, October 18. The total charged is $432.18, with no parking included or required. Cancellation is free through 11:59 p.m. local time Wednesday, October 14; a late cancellation costs one night's room and tax. Shall I complete that booking?

Booked. The Hyatt Place Columbus/OSU king room is confirmed for October 16-18 under confirmation HPO-781463, total $432.18. No parking charge was added, and cancellation remains available without penalty through 11:59 p.m. October 14. With a $20 incidental rideshare allowance, lodging and local transportation total $452.18. The Friday pickup target is 3:00 p.m. at CMH, and the Sunday airport departure target is 12:35 p.m.
